Acquisition of Land Act 1984
ACQUISITION OF LAND (RATE OF INTEREST AFTER
ENTRY) REGULATIONS 19841
Made: 30 May 1984
In exercise of the powers conferred on the Finance Board by section 30(3) of the
Acquisition of Land Act 19841, and of all other enabling powers, the following
Regulations are hereby made: —
1 Citation
These Regulations may be cited as the Acquisition of Land (Rate of Interest after
Entry) Regulations 1984.
2 Rate of Interest
The rate of interest on any compensation in respect of the compulsory acquisition
of an interest in land on which entry has been made before the payment of
compensation shall be the rate from time to time prescribed by regulations under
section 32(1) of the Land Compensation Act 1961 (an Act of Parliament)2.
